lessons_used: Predictions overall tended to overestimate positive impact (especially in rounds 1, 2, and 5), but underestimated gains in winning tests during rounds 3, 4, and 6.
home wait_info changes can be helpful, backed by 3 winning tests (rounds 3, 4, and 7), though 2 tests showed no clear effect (rounds 1 and 5).
sign_in hint changes can be helpful, backed by 2 winning tests (rounds 4 and 6), though 4 tests showed no clear effect (rounds 1, 2, 5, and 7).
choose_path layout changes showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests (rounds 1 and 5).
home notification changes showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests (rounds 2 and 6).
Evidence remains thin for adoption redesign, finish new_flow, and finish new_screen because their test outcomes disagree, as well as for all kinds of change with only a single test.

candidates.title: Certificate Audio Preview Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the adoption certificate screen into a split layout featuring interactive pet audio reaction samples and a mascot preview before confirmation.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops off significantly (66.2% conversion, 89s median) and support reported post-onboarding confusion on how to talk to or interact with pets.

adoption_certificate.headline: Meet & Verify Your New Companion
adoption_certificate.body: Listen to voice samples and confirm adoption details to ensure your pet fits your workspace setup.

guard.reason: The redesigned adoption certificate removes the required official stamp.

candidates.title: Desktop Tray Launch Prep Screen
candidates.change: Add a new dedicated screen before completing onboarding explaining how to invoke, hide, and manage the pet from the system desktop tray.
candidates.why: Finish step takes median 395s (mean 5815s) and 7 support tickets reported pets missing on desktop or confusion around hiding/controlling pets.

home_intro.headline: Welcome to Your New Workspace!
home_intro.body: Your pet is active and ready on your desktop screen.

new_desktop_launch_prep.headline: Desktop Control & Tray Guide
new_desktop_launch_prep.body: Your pet resides in your system tray. Right-click the icon anytime to summon, hide, or open companion options.

guard.reason: Adding an instructional tray prep screen before home intro inside onboarding complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen to finish step has negative historical performance (-4.7%) and high development cost.

candidates.title: Pet Trait Audio Tuning Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a interactive personality tuning stage on pick_friend with dynamic audio reaction previews and workspace advice tip carousels.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 66.2%, and custom pet creation failures featured in support complaints.

pick_friend.headline: Select Companion Personality Traits
pick_friend.body: Choose personality tendencies and test sound cues to customize how your pet reacts to your work habits.

components.text: Calm pets stay quiet during focus hours; energetic pets trigger quick animations.

guard.reason: Redefining pick_friend to select personality traits removes the required functionality of choosing a pet.

candidates.title: Animated Story Intro Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the story intro screen with full bleed video previews showing real desktop pet interactions across different operating workflows.
candidates.why: The choose_path stage has a high mean time of 514s, showing initial user hesitation or lack of context regarding desktop pet mechanics.

story.headline: Transform Your Workspace
story.body: See how an interactive desktop pet seamlessly integrates with your apps and productivity routines.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen to feature video previews still introduces the pet and complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Video preview redesign requires release effort with weak evidence from only 1 past test (+0.3%).

candidates.title: Account Pet Data Preservation Notice
candidates.change: Display an explicit data protection hint on sign-in clarifying that pet progress and custom creations are securely saved to the account.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) reported pets missing or resetting after re-signing into their account.

sign_in.hint: Signing in anchors your companion to this account so your custom pet is never lost when logging in across devices.

guard.reason: Adding a data preservation hint to the sign-in screen is permitted within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Config-only hint addressing top support complaint (8 emails) with 2 past winning sign_in hint tests (+1.8% avg).

candidates.title: Desktop Render Step Timer & Animation
candidates.change: Add an animated visual render progress indicator with a real-time step countdown timer to the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The home waiting stage takes a long median of 201s (mean 2336s), and wait_info changes are supported by 3 winning historical tests.

waiting.headline: Building Desktop Animations
waiting.body: Generating companion graphics and asset packs tailored to your desktop resolution.

guard.reason: Adding a progress indicator and timer for a real render wait is allowed on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info has the strongest pattern with 3 historical winning tests (+1.8% avg) targeting long wait times.

candidates.title: Render Completion Audio Notification Toggle
candidates.change: Add an audio completion alert switch and chime test button on the waiting screen so users know when generation finishes while backgrounded.
candidates.why: High average waiting time (2336s) leads users to background the app or think it stalled, causing dropoffs or app non-opening tickets.

waiting.hint: Turn on completion alert chime so you can safely minimize the window while your pet renders.

guard.reason: Adding an optional render completion audio toggle to the waiting screen complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Home notification changes consistently showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests (+0.6% avg).

candidates.title: Photo Upload Quality Grid Layout
candidates.change: Change upload_photos screen to a structured grid layout with photo lighting quality checklist cards.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or producing distorted results due to poor input photos during adoption.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Photos for 3D Customization
upload_photos.body: Provide clear photos for optimal mesh generation and accurate companion styling.

components.text: Well-lit photo with clear background contrast

guard.reason: Asks the user to upload personal photos.

candidates.title: Home Desktop Companion Bonus Badge
candidates.change: Add a Founder Companion early unlock badge and welcome reward highlight component to home_intro.
candidates.why: Finish conversion drops to 75.6% with long completion times (mean 5815s); rewarding users at the final step encourages completion.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet Has Arrived!
home_intro.body: You have unlocked exclusive starter accessories and founder status for your desktop companion.

guard.reason: Promoting unlocked starter accessories and reward badges in onboarding copy violates Rule 3 regarding free extras/gifts.

candidates.title: Path Companion Purpose Explainer Copy
candidates.change: Update choose_path headline and body to explicitly differentiate focus assistant pets from casual idle companions.
candidates.why: Choose path stage takes mean 514s with 79.6% conversion, indicating user confusion about which path best suits their needs.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Companion's Mode
choose_path.body: Select 'Focus Partner' for gentle work reminders or 'Idle Companion' for fun background desk animations. Easily switch anytime.

guard.reason: Changing choose_path to choose between companion modes loses the required options of adopting versus making your own pet.

lessons_next: Predictions overall tended to overestimate positive impact (especially in rounds 1, 2, and 5), but underestimated gains in winning tests during rounds 3, 4, and 6.
home wait_info changes can be helpful, backed by 3 winning tests (rounds 3, 4, and 7), though 3 tests showed no clear effect (rounds 1, 5, and 8).
sign_in hint changes can be helpful, backed by 2 winning tests (rounds 4 and 6), though 5 tests showed no clear effect (rounds 1, 2, 5, 7, and 8).
choose_path layout changes showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests (rounds 1 and 5).
home notification changes showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests (rounds 2 and 6).
Evidence remains thin for adoption redesign, finish new_flow, finish new_screen, and choose_path redesign due to disagreeing outcomes, as well as for all kinds of change with only a single test.
